messages:
Jordan Lee: Heads up 1: we need to lock the offer formats across AWS/GCP/Azure for the new release. Decision window today.
Rina Gupta: Agree. My take: default to SaaS marketplace offers for hosted, VM/AMI only for Dedicated image distribution. Keeps provisioning simpler.
Omar Velazquez: Ok but note that some regions require AMI-style entitlements to automate marketplace billing. We should list exceptions.
Hannah Kim: Can we make a matrix in the doc? Columns: cloud, offer_type, provisioning_flow, entitlements, expected_lead_time. I'll create it.
Jordan Lee: Please also add "who approves security scan" and "maintainer" columns. We keep getting questions from partners about patch cadence.
Rina Gupta: I'll put sample cells. Example row for AWS SaaS: `offer_type: SaaS`, `provisioning_flow: redirect + SSO`, `entitlements: license_token`, `lead_time: 1 week`
Omar Velazquez: For GCP, we need to include a service account for automated provisioning. Note in the doc: required IAM roles and sample terraform snippet.
Hannah Kim: Adding terraform snippet for GCP provisioning: ```hcl
resource "google_service_account" "marketplace_provisioner" {
  account_id   = "rwd-marketplace-provisioner"
  display_name = "Redwood Marketplace Provisioner"
}```
billing-bot: FYI 1: marketplace billing model choices will affect invoicing flows. Use `billing-model: per_token` or `billing-model: subscription` tags in the manifest.
Jordan Lee: Important: which billing model are we defaulting to for Hosted? Per-token is most accurate but partners push subscription for predictability. Thoughts?
Rina Gupta: Suggest per-token with a subscription fallback flag. Marketplace UI can show both options; we pick default per-offer.
Omar Velazquez: Also, include marketplace_fee splitting in the price table. Some marketplaces add 20-25% on top of our sticker.
Hannah Kim: Catalog-bot will check our asset list for missing thumbnails. catalog-bot: missing thumbnails: gcp, azure (large icon).
catalog-bot: Please upload 1200x900 JPG and 1024x1024 PNG for compliance.
Jordan Lee: Legal note: we must include DPA and export-control language in the offer metadata. Rina, can you coordinate with legal to add the exact clauses?
Rina Gupta: I'll sync with legal and paste the approved snippet into the doc. ETA 48 hrs.
Omar Velazquez: On entitlements: we should support both marketplace-managed entitlements (for automated provisioning) and our server-side license checks (for revocation). Proposed rule: marketplace_entitlement required only for auto-provision flows.
Hannah Kim: I added the rule to the matrix and a short flow diagram (in-doc). Also added a checklist section: images, docs, security scan report, pricing table, SKU mapping, license endpoint URL.
Jordan Lee: Can each owner add their Jira ticket to the checklist? We need traceability for publishing.
Rina Gupta: Done 1: added PL-9010 for SKU mapping.
Omar Velazquez: Added PL-9021 for AMI build and scanning.
Jordan Lee: Great. Final ask: if anyone sees a marketplace that requires extra metadata, flag it here now. Otherwise we'll lock the doc at 5pm and move to approvals.
Rina Gupta: No other blockers from my side. Locking @5pm sounds good.
Hannah Kim: I'll run one final asset check and then mark the doc ready for approvals.
catalog-bot: Reminder scheduled: marketplace asset upload deadline 2026-04-02 17:00 PT.
Jordan Lee: Thanks team 1: we'll review approvals tomorrow.
